source_file_comparison: Preprocessor, Jev adapter, context preselection, Workflow service/discovery, model routing and web send handler matched between review checkout, Plan workspace and runtime files. This does not establish historical or in-memory module revisions.

phase_query.selection: most recent matching worker-app-ai spans; 300-row cap reached

first_token_query.selection: most recent matching worker-app-ai turn, preprocess, queue and provider spans; 250-row cap reached

limits: These are bounded dev samples, not population percentiles or this user's identified request.
Capped queries have incomplete and differing cohorts; phase medians must not be added.
Worker first-token timing excludes client preparation and earlier API/preflight work, and is not guaranteed to mean visible answer prose.
The Jev-to-result interval includes surrounding adapter work and both stages; individual HTTP stage latency was not measured.
HTTP counts were correlated within worker-log intervals, not individually parented child spans; concurrent interleaving cannot be completely excluded.
Historical spans may precede the present runtime revision; browser and native paint costs were not profiled.
